analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for two consecutive sessions. RSI at 59.0 has exited overbought territory and continues to consolidate in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows weak improvement, shrinking to 0.0021. Volume ratio at 0.45 indicates contraction. No Higher Low pattern formed with 5-day low at $0.21 and 20-day low at $0.17. Price is consolidating between swing support at $0.17 and resistance at $0.21.
